title: Chapter 582 - 582 Freshwater Resources; Increase By 10%!
content:
Chapter 582 - 582 Freshwater Resources; Increase By 10%!

Chapter 582 - 582 Freshwater Resources; Increase by 10%!

582 Freshwater Resources; Increase by 10%!

The scene in Hua Nation’s live broadcast room froze at this moment.

The audience’s mouths were wide open, and their faces were filled with shock.

Xiao Bing was stunned. “What just happened?”

Her voice evoked countless comments to appear.

[Guardian World Flame: [F*ck!]

Quick Guest: [F*ck!]

Stone Golem: [F*ck!]

Little Light: [Awesome!]

Qingchun: [Awesome!]

Song: [Awesome!]

…

The audience was shocked, but they did not know how to express it.

Thus, the entire screen was filled with classic curses.

After a long while, someone asked in confusion.

Joan: [What happened just now? Why did that crocodile monster suddenly snap into two?]

Too Crazy: [I watched the replay just now. Professor Lin only pulled out his sword, and then the crocodile monster died.]

World: [Drawing a sword and shooting out a dazzling sword ray. This is better than the special effects in movies!]

Water: [The method of the gods, this is definitely the method of the gods!]

Heaven and Earth No. 1: [So awesome!]

Painter: [My mom asked me why I was kneeling while watching the live broadcast.]

Sun Moon: [Who still dares to say that God Lin can’t survive?]

Green Grassland: [Ai Jin actually said that God Lin was so scared that he couldn’t move.]

Asylum Director: [F*ck! He said such a thing? Let’s not talk about it anymore. Let’s report him!]

Horse-Faced Man: [Ai Jin has been slandering and belittling God Lin outside. Report him directly!]

World Ghost: [I already reported him last time. Why wasn’t he banned?]]

Fruit Tea: [I won’t say much. Continue reporting!]]

…

Compared to everyone’s surprise, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, and the others were full of joy.

The stronger Lin Fan was, the safer he would be.

This was what they hoped for the most.

…

Ai Jin also saw Lin Fan kill the crocodile monster with his sword. He was stunned.

Obviously, this was also beyond Ai Jin’s expectations.

However, when he saw the increasing number of views, as well as countless insults and reports, his daze was replaced by joy.

As long as the number of views rose, it meant that his popularity was high.

The higher the popularity, the more money!

This was a theorem.

As for the insults and reports…

Ai Jin did not take it to heart.

Because the technical director of the blog was his cousin. No matter how many reports they made, it would be useless.

However…

At this moment, a message suddenly popped up on Ai Jin’s blog.

[Notice: Due to your violation of the relevant regulations, your blog has been permanently banned.]

Seeing this…

Ai Jin was stunned.

What was going on?

His blog was banned?

How was this possible?

Yes, it must have been a mistake.

At the thought of this, Ai Jin picked up his phone and was about to call his cousin.

However, before he could dial the number…

The phone rang urgently.

Ai Jin looked at the caller ID. It was his cousin!

Hence, Ai Jin hurriedly pressed the answer button.

However, before he could speak, his cousin’s roar sounded from inside.

“What the f*ck did you do?

“I suppressed your report and was dismissed by the leader for it!

“Damn it!

“Do you know how much effort I put in to become the technical director?

“It’s all gone now!”

…

Ai Jin opened his mouth nervously and was about to say something.

Just then, there was a dull knock on the door from outside.

“Hello, is anyone there?

“Can you open the door?

“We’re here to check the water meter!”

Ai Jin had no choice but to slowly open the door.

The next moment, two investigators walked in and said, “Hello, we discovered that you’re slandering our hero online. In addition, we’ve found that your account has transactions with an overseas organization. Please come with us.”

Ai Jin’s phone fell to the ground, and his face turned pale.

…

Naturally, Lin Fan had no idea about all of this.

He looked at the power of his sword, and the corners of his mouth curled up slightly, revealing a faint smile.

At this moment, an emotionless voice rang out beside Lin Fan’s ears.

[You’re the first player to kill a level-three Giant Crocodile. You’ve obtained a level-three treasure chest.]

[You’re the first player to kill a level-three Giant Crocodile. Hua Nation’s freshwater resources have increased by 10%.]

Then, an ancient chest appeared in front of Lin Fan.

He had already opened the chest twice.

This time, he opened the box without hesitation.

[30 points of Constitution. Do you want to use them?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet of 300 Constitution points.]

With an increase of 300 points, Lin Fan’s bones and muscles grew by a whole fold.

Then, they quickly returned to their original state, becoming stronger and more condensed.

Then, Lin Fan lowered his head and touched the orb of light in the ancient chest.

His constitution increased by another 30 points!

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Wheatspike: [The Giant Crocodile is a level-three monster. No wonder it’s so terrifying!]

Fruit Tea: [God Lin obtained 30 Constitution points. I wonder how strong he is now.]

North: [Hua Nation’s freshwater resources have increased by 10%. Everyone, take a look and see if there are any changes.]]

The Person on the Summit: [F*ck, f*ck, f*ck! Suddenly, a long river that’s hundreds of meters wide appeared in Bin Province!]

Youth Won’t Come: [It’s the same in Te Province!]

Rest: [One has appeared in Qi Province too!]

Rumble: [Long rivers have appeared in Qi Province, Te Province, and Bin Province? In other words, this long river flowed directly from the west to the east. Isn’t this a super river that’s not inferior to the Yellow River and the Yangtze River?!]

Sadness: [Haha! Qi Province finally has a big river. Now, we don’t have to worry about water anymore!]

Your Highness: [I don’t know what words to use to express the excitement in my heart. I can only say it’s f*cking awesome!]

Black and White: [F*ck awesome!]

Guoguo: [F*ck, awesome!]

…

If an ordinary person encountered a clear lake after a few days, they would definitely want to take a bath.

However, Lin Fan was wearing a dust-proof coat, so there would not be any stains.

There was no need to wash it.

Of course, the most important reason was that the blood of the giant crocodile had already flowed into the lake, and it was very smelly.

Lin Fan was a little disgusted.

Therefore, he did not stay by the lake and went straight away.

He passed through the bushes and arrived in front of a forest.

The sun gradually set, and the sky began to turn yellow.

Not far away, two half-meter-tall rabbits were squatting on the ground and eating grass silently.

Lin Fan muttered, “It seems like I can only eat one. But if I let the other go, wouldn’t it lose a playmate? I’ll deal with them both, then.]

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan’s mind moved slightly.

[Skill: Gravity Control!]

In an instant, the two large rabbits seemed to have been crushed by a huge mountain that fell from the sky. They directly fell to the ground, unable to resist at all.

Then, Lin Fan took out his knife and easily skinned the two rabbits.
